title: 第五章 迷殺之光第六章 赤鳕之泪
lines: 第五章：迷榖之光
绕开“丽麂之水”的路并不好走。
土著指引的那条小径，与其说是路，不如说是一条由藤蔓和树根编织成的天然隧道。两旁是高达数十米的桄榔树（arengapinnata），巨大的羽状叶片像巨大的伞盖，将天空遮挡得严严实实，只在叶隙间漏下几缕惨淡的白光，勉强照亮脚下湿滑的腐殖层。
空气变得异常闷热潮湿，每一口呼吸都像是在吞咽一碗温热的洗脚水。这里的生物多样性达到了一个令人咋舌的程度。脚下的泥土里，成群的长着夸张大颚的巨螽（一种史前蟋蟀）在奔逃；头顶的树冠上，拖着长长的尾羽、叫声像玻璃摩擦的窃脂鸟在跳跃。
“停下。”
黄海涛突然抬手，示意李元茜止步。他的地质锤指向前方一棵倒塌的树干。
那树干上，密密麻麻地趴满了一种奇特的昆虫。它们外形像蜜蜂，但体型有拇指大小，通体呈现出一种病态的苍白，翅膀是透明的，边缘带着一圈黑色的边框。最诡异的是，它们并不飞行，而是像壁虎一样吸附在树皮上，尾部一根细长的刺深深扎进树干内部，像是在输液一样吸取着树液。
“新的物种？”李元茜举起相机，调整微距镜头，“这翅膀的结构……脉序完全不同于现代膜翅目昆虫。你看它的复眼，那是六边形还是五边形？”
“别碰。”黄海涛低声警告，但他的话音刚落，李元茜已经按下了快门。
咔嚓。
清脆的快门声在寂静的森林里显得格外刺耳。
那一瞬间，仿佛某种开关被触发了。趴在树干上的数百只“白蜂”齐刷刷地停止了动作。它们缓缓转过头，那数百双复眼在昏暗的光线下，反射出一种令人毛骨悚然的绿光。
紧接着，它们集体振翅。
那不是普通的蜂鸣，而是一种极低频的、像是从地狱深处传来的轰鸣声。声波像实质化的重锤，狠狠撞击在两人的胸口。黄海涛感到一阵气血翻涌，喉头一甜，差点吐出血来。李元茜更是直接瘫软在地，耳膜剧痛，眼前一片漆黑。
“跑！”黄海涛一把拽起李元茜，顾不上背包的重量，拼命向后跑去。
那些“白蜂”并没有追击。它们只是静静地悬浮在树干周围，那幽绿的复眼像鬼火一样盯着两个闯入者的背影，直到两人狼狈地冲进一片开阔地，才缓缓收敛了光芒，重新吸附回树干上。
“那是什么鬼东西……”李元茜大口喘息着，脸色惨白，“次声波武器？生物版的？”
“不，比那个更精妙。”黄海涛扶着膝盖，心有余悸，“那是群体共振。它们的翅膀频率完全一致，能产生定向的声压冲击波。就像一群微型轰炸机编队。”
他抬头看向前方。刚才那阵亡命奔逃，让他们冲出了密林，来到了一处巨大的山谷盆地。
这里的景色与之前的丛林截然不同。地面上没有参天大树，只有低矮的灌木和一种长着巨大叶片的草本植物。而在盆地的中央，生长着一棵孤零零的巨树。
那棵树太显眼了。它的树干并不粗壮，但高度惊人，直插云霄，仿佛是连接天地的一根柱子。树冠呈现出一种完美的半球形，像一朵巨大的蘑菇。最奇特的是，整棵树通体呈现出一种半透明的乳白色，在昏暗的天光下，散发着柔和的、如同月光般的晕光。
“《南山经》里说，‘有木焉，其状如榖而黑理，其华四照，其名曰迷榖，佩之不迷。’”李元茜喘匀了气，看着那棵发光的树，眼中闪烁着狂热的光芒，“那就是……迷榖树？”
“华四照……”黄海涛仰头望着那棵巨树，“古人说的是不是它的花？但这棵树现在没有开花。”
就在这时，山谷里起风了。
那风并不猛烈，但带着一种奇异的韵律。随着风势的加强，那棵迷榖树的树冠开始轻轻摇曳。原本紧闭的叶片缓缓张开，露出了里面层层叠叠的花序。
那些花并不是花瓣，而是一簇簇细小的、如同蒲公英般的绒球。当风穿过树冠时，那些绒球释放出无数细小的、发光的孢子。
那些孢子并不是无序飘散的。它们在气流中汇聚，像一支训练有素的军队，在空中排列成复杂的几何图形。先是圆形，然后是螺旋线，最后定格成一个巨大的、立体的网格结构，将整棵迷榖树包裹在其中。
“全息投影！”李元茜惊呼，“是光学的！”
那些孢子网格在空中散射着光线，将阳光分解成七彩的光谱。在光与影的交错中，迷榖树的树干上，再次浮现出了那些复杂的图案——河流、山脉、部落的标记。
但这一次，更加清晰，更加立体。
黄海涛甚至看到了流动的河水，看到了山脉背后的阴影，看到了一个用红色线条标记的、闪烁的箭头，指向了迷榖树的正南方。
“那是……路线图？”黄海涛眯起眼睛，试图记住每一个细节，“它指向了哪里？”
“不知道，但肯定是个重要的地方。”李元茜迅速用画笔和水彩纸临摹着空中的投影，“这种导航方式太先进了。这棵树就像一个天然的gps卫星，通过释放光孢子来构建实时地图。”

Chapter 5: The Lost Light
1.
The way around "Liji Water" is not easy.
The trail guided by the natives is not so much a road as a natural tunnel woven by vines and tree roots. On both sides are palm trees (arengapinnata) that are tens of meters high. Their huge feathery leaves are like huge umbrellas, completely blocking the sky. Only a few wisps of pale white light leak through the gaps between the leaves, barely illuminating the slippery humus layer underfoot.
The air became extremely hot and humid, and every breath felt like swallowing a bowl of warm foot-washing water. The biodiversity here is staggering. In the soil beneath our feet, swarms of giant katydids (a kind of prehistoric cricket) with exaggerated jaws were scurrying; in the canopy above our heads, fat-stealing birds with long tail feathers and sounds like glass friction were jumping.
"Stop."
Huang Haitao suddenly raised his hand to signal Li Yuanqian to stop. His geological hammer points ahead at a fallen tree trunk.
The tree trunk was densely covered with a strange insect. They look like bees, but are about the size of a thumb. Their bodies are sickly pale, their wings are transparent, and they have a black border around the edges. The weirdest thing is that they don't fly, but stick to the bark of the tree like a gecko. A slender thorn at the tail digs deep into the trunk, sucking the sap like an infusion.
"A new species?" Li Yuanqian raised the camera and adjusted the macro lens, "The structure of this wing...the vein sequence is completely different from modern hymenoptera insects. Look at its compound eyes, are they hexagonal or pentagonal?"
"Don't touch." Huang Haitao warned in a low voice, but as soon as he finished speaking, Li Yuanqian had already pressed the shutter.
Click.
The crisp sound of the shutter is particularly harsh in the silent forest.
At that moment, it was as if some kind of switch was triggered. Hundreds of "white bees" lying on the tree trunks all stopped moving. They slowly turned their heads, and those hundreds of pairs of compound eyes reflected a creepy green light in the dim light.
Then, they flapped their wings collectively.
Buzz——
It was not an ordinary buzz, but an extremely low-frequency roar that sounded like it was coming from the depths of hell. The sound wave was like a substantial hammer, hitting their chests hard. Huang Haitao felt a surge of energy and blood, his throat felt so sweet that he almost vomited blood. Li Yuanqian collapsed directly to the ground, her eardrums were in severe pain, and her vision was dark.
"Run!" Huang Haitao grabbed Li Yuanqian and ran backwards desperately, regardless of the weight of the backpack.
Those "white bees" did not pursue. They just floated around the tree trunk quietly, their green compound eyes staring at the backs of the two intruders like will-o'-the-wisps. It wasn't until the two of them rushed into an open space in embarrassment that they slowly converged their light and returned to the tree trunk.
"What the hell is that..." Li Yuanqian gasped, her face pale, "Infrasonic weapon? Biological version?"
"No, it's more subtle than that." Huang Haitao held his knees, with lingering fear. "That's group resonance. Their wings have exactly the same frequency and can produce directional sound pressure shock waves. It's like a formation of a group of micro-bombers."
He looked up and ahead. The desperate escape just now caused them to break out of the dense forest and arrive at a huge valley basin.
The scenery here is completely different from the previous jungle. There were no towering trees on the ground, only low shrubs and an herbaceous plant with huge leaves. In the center of the basin, a solitary giant tree grew.
That tree stands out so much. Its trunk is not thick, but its height is astonishing. It reaches straight into the sky, as if it is a pillar connecting heaven and earth. The crown of the tree is a perfect hemisphere, like a giant mushroom. The most peculiar thing is that the entire tree is translucent and milky white, exuding a soft, moonlight-like halo under the dim skylight.
"The "Nanshan Sutra" says, 'There is a tree. Its shape is like a walnut, but its texture is black, and its flowers are shining in all directions. Its name is called the miraculous tree. If you wear it, you will not be lost.'" Li Yuanqian took a breath and looked at the glowing tree, with a fanatical light in her eyes. "Is that... the miraculous tree?"
"Hua Si Zhao..." Huang Haitao looked up at the giant tree, "Did the ancients talk about its flowers? But the tree is not blooming now."
Just then, the wind started blowing in the valley.
The wind was not violent, but it carried a strange rhythm. As the wind intensified, the crown of the mist tree began to sway gently. The originally closed leaves slowly opened, revealing the layers of inflorescences inside.
Those flowers are not petals, but clusters of tiny, dandelion-like pompons. As the wind blows through the canopy, those pom-poms release countless tiny, glowing spores.
Those spores are not scattered randomly. They gather in the airflow, like a well-trained army, arranged in complex geometric shapes in the air. First it was a circle, then a spiral, and finally it was settled into a huge, three-dimensional grid structure, wrapping the entire Myrtle tree in it.
"Holographic projection!" Li Yuanqian exclaimed, "It's optical!"
Those spore grids scatter light across the sky, breaking sunlight into a spectrum of colors. In the interplay of light and shadow, those complex patterns - rivers, mountains, tribal markings - appeared again on the trunk of the mist tree.
But this time, it's clearer and more three-dimensional.
Huang Haitao even saw the flowing river, the shadows behind the mountains, and a flashing arrow marked with a red line, pointing directly south of the Myrtle Tree.
"Is that... a road map?" Huang Haitao squinted his eyes, trying to remember every detail, "Where does it point to?"
